highlights: Microsoft sign-in is safer: fresh actions ask for a fresh Microsoft sign-in, and Microsoft sessions end after 24 hours at the latest.
Microsoft Entra syncs users and groups only. It never assigns roles; you choose the role yourself, also for bulk invitations.
Restricted ITGlue entries stay restricted on import; an export without a "restricted" column stops the import.
Clearer messages for expired invitations, and notices to tenant admins when an external person invites.
